core_obligations: The author converts logarithmic power bases into bounded-width polylogarithmic Cayley circuits and implements their evaluation by the double-barrel recursive boundary predicate, proving the required polynomial-size O(log log n)-depth circuit bound for an entire subsemigroup-closed class. The class-level width/certificate construction and recursion remain the residual nonroutine work. Group membership from the quoted Babai-Szemeredi lemma and commutative specializations are supporting context, not extra counted results.
